# Bundled typefaces

Manrope remains the vendor application's approved typeface.

Inter is used for the approved owner pages on Android and web. The variable font
includes weight and optical-size axes. Source:
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/inter
Downloaded 22 October 2026. The SIL Open Font License and copyright notice are in
`Inter-OFL.txt`. Fonts are loaded from the app bundle, never fetched at runtime.

iOS owner pages use Flutter's CupertinoSystemText/CupertinoSystemDisplay aliases
for the native San Francisco font. No Apple font files are bundled or redistributed.
